# bitbucket_group (Resource)

A workspace group. Uses Bitbucket Cloud's legacy v1.0 API, since there is no v2.0 replacement for group management.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_group" "release_managers" {
  name       = "Release Managers"
  permission = "write"
  auto_add   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the group.

### Optional

- `auto_add` (Boolean) Whether new workspace members are automatically added to this group. Defaults to false.
- `permission` (String) Default repository permission granted to new members: "read", "write" or "admin". Leave unset for no default permission.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/slug".
- `slug` (String) Bitbucket-assigned slug of the group, derived from its name.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_group.release_managers release-managers
```
